description: Smoke fixture for the bundled generate_video package: the recipe answers with the fixed line the chat turn gives the model. In a chat turn the hub answers the call itself and starts the video job (backend/src/lib/videos/tool.ts); that path is covered by backend/tests/videoTool.test.ts, not this emulator.

inputs.prompt: a paper boat in the rain

reply.text: A 5 second video is being made from this description: a paper boat in the rain. It appears below your reply when it is ready and takes about two minutes. You have not seen it: do not describe how it looks. Tell the person in one short sentence that it is on its way and about how long it takes.
